spec.description:
Collect hardware health and performance metrics as well as sustainability KPIs with MetricsHub®; visualize the gathered telemetry data in the comprehensive Hardware Main (MetricsHub), Hardware Site (MetricsHub), and Hardware Host (MetricsHub) dashboards.

MetricsHubs collects metrics from servers (Cisco, Dell, HPE, Huawei, IBM Lenovo, SuperMicro, etc.), storage systems (NetApp, Dell EMC, Hitachi, HPE, IBM, Pure, Huawei, etc.), network devices (Cisco, Aruba, Dell, HP, F5, Juniper, Oracle) and other equipment like PDUs, UPS from APC, Raritan, Eaton, etc.

spec.title: Yearly Cost
spec.description:
The sites' yearly cost.

These values are estimated according to the past data if less than a year of data has been collected.

spec.expr: avg_over_time(sum by (site) (hw_host_power_watts)[1y:1d]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[1y:1d]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_electricity_cost)[1y:1d]) * 365 * 24 / 1000

spec.title: Yearly CO₂
spec.description:
The sites' yearly CO₂ emissions. 

These values are estimated according to the past data if less than a year of data has been collected.

spec.expr: avg_over_time(sum by (site) (hw_host_power_watts)[1y:1d]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[1y:1d]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_carbon_intensity_grams)[1y:1d]) * 365 * 24 / 1000 / 1000 / 1000

spec.title: Yearly Consumption
spec.description:
The sites' yearly power consumption.

These values are estimated according to the past data if less than a year of data has been collected.

spec.title: Total Power
spec.description: Total current power usage of all hosts across all sites.

spec.title: Hosts Type
spec.description: The total number of hosts per type: compute (server), storage and network.

spec.title: Power per Platform Type
spec.description:
The power consumption distribution across platform types: 
HP-UX, IBM AIX, Management (i.e management card), Microsoft Windows, Linux, 
Oracle Solaris and Storage.

spec.title: Power per Host Type
spec.description: The power consumption distribution by host types: compute (server), storage and network.

spec.title: Top Consumers
spec.description: The 10 hosts that currently consume the most energy across all sites.

spec.title: Total Power * PUE
spec.description:
Total current power usage across all sites, multiplied by the site's PUE.

This number represents the actual power usage of all sites. It takes into account the cooling and other overhead that supports the equipment.

spec.title: Hosts
spec.description: The number of hosts currently configured to be monitored.

spec.title: Hosts Ambient Temperature
spec.description:
The 25 hosts reporting the hottest ambient temperature.

Click on a host for details.

spec.title: Hosts Highest Temperature Sensor
spec.description:
The temperature sensors reporting the highest temperatures at the moment.

Click on a temperature for details.

spec.title: Hosts Vendor
spec.description: The hosts distribution per manufacturer.

spec.expr:
sum(count by (host_name, site) (avg_over_time(metricshub_host_configured[1h]))) by (site)
/
scalar(sum(count by (host_name, site) (avg_over_time(metricshub_host_configured[1h]))))

spec.title: Yearly Consumption
spec.description:
The overall power consumption reported for all sites during the last year.

If less than 365 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.title: Yearly Cost
spec.description:
The overall energy cost of all sites for the past year.

If less than 365 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.expr: sum(avg_over_time(sum by (site) (hw_host_power_watts)[1y:1d]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[1y:1d]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_electricity_cost)[1y:1d])) * 365 * 24 / 1000

spec.title: Monthly CO₂ Emissions
spec.description:
The overall volume of CO₂ emitted by all the sites for the last 30 days.

If less than 30 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.

spec.expr: sum(avg_over_time(sum by (site) (hw_host_power_watts)[30d:1h]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[30d:1h]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_carbon_intensity_grams)[30d:1h])) * 30.467 * 24 / 1000 / 1000 / 1000

spec.title: Monthly Consumption
spec.description:
The overall power consumption reported for all sites during the last 30 days.

If less than 30 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.title: Monthly Cost
spec.description:
The overall energy cost of all sites for the last 30 days.

If less than 30 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.expr: sum(avg_over_time(sum by (site) (hw_host_power_watts)[30d:1h]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[30d:1h]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_electricity_cost)[30d:1h])) * 30.437 * 24 / 1000

spec.title: Yearly CO₂ Emissions
spec.description:
The overall volume of CO₂ emitted by all the sites for the past year.

If less than 365 days of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.

spec.expr: sum(avg_over_time(sum by (site) (hw_host_power_watts)[1y:1d]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[1y:1d]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_carbon_intensity_grams)[1y:1d])) * 365 * 24 / 1000 / 1000 / 1000

spec.title: Daily Consumption
spec.description:
The overall power consumption reported for all sites in the last 24 hours.

If less than 24 hours of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.

spec.title: Today's Live Cost
spec.description: Today's total power cost for all sites.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (site) (increase(hw_host_energy_joules_total[$__range])) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[$__range:5m]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_electricity_cost)[$__range:5m])) / 3600 / 1000

spec.title: Daily CO₂ Emissions
spec.description:
The overall volume of CO₂ emitted by all the sites for the last 24 hours.

If less than 24 hours of data is available, this value is estimated based on the past collected data.

spec.expr: sum(avg_over_time(sum by (site) (hw_host_power_watts)[1d:5m]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[1d:5m]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_carbon_intensity_grams)[1d:5m])) * 24 / 1000 / 1000 / 1000

spec.title: Daily Energy Consumption (last 30 days)
spec.description: The overall daily energy consumption for the past 30 days, as reported.

spec.title: Collect Started
spec.description: Time since the collect of data by Hardware Sentry was first started.

spec.title: Coverage
spec.description:
The percentage of monitored hosts.

A monitored host is a host with at least one responding connector.

spec.expr: count(max by (host_name, site) (metricshub_connector_status{state="ok"} == 1)) / sum(max by (host_name, site) (present_over_time(metricshub_host_configured[1h])))

spec.title: Margin of Error
spec.description:
The power consumption's margin of error.

This value is based on the number of hosts that report measured power consumptions and the number of hosts whose power consumption is estimated.

When the power consumed by a host cannot be read, Hardware Sentry estimates this value based on the host's components (CPUs, disks, network interfaces, etc.) and their usage.

spec.expr:
label_replace(
  ALERTS_FOR_STATE{site != "", host_name != "", alertname=~"MetricsHub-Hardware-.*"},
  "alertname",
  "$1",
  "alertname",
  "MetricsHub-Hardware-(.*)" # To remove the MetricsHub prefix from the alert name
)

spec.title: Total Power * PUE
spec.description:
Total current power usage across all sites, multiplied by the site's PUE, displayed as a graph.

This number represents the actual power usage of all sites. It takes into account the cooling and other overhead that supports the equipment.

spec.title: Today's Live Consumption
spec.description: Today's total power consumption for all sites.

spec.title: Today's Live CO₂ Emissions
spec.description: Today's volume of CO₂ emissions for all sites.

spec.expr: sum(sum by (site) (increase(hw_host_energy_joules_total[$__range])) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[$__range:5m]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_carbon_intensity_grams)[$__range:5m])) / 3600 / 1000 / 1000 / 1000

spec.title: Daily Cost
spec.description:
The overall energy cost of all sites for the last 24 hours.

If less than 24 hours of data is available, this value is estimated based on past collected data.

spec.expr: sum(avg_over_time(sum by (site) (hw_host_power_watts)[1d:5m]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_pue_ratio)[1d:5m]) * avg_over_time(avg by (site) (hw_site_electricity_cost)[1d:5m])) * 24 / 1000
